reason: Complete Step-1 proof route: Choose an affine neighborhood of t and finitely many affine-local pieces of the inverse image, each a closed subscheme of a distinguished open D(f) in that neighborhood. A finite union of closures contains t, so one piece does. In A_p/I, with p=t, f is not nilpotent; the proper ideal argument yields q⊂p containing I and avoiding f. This q is the required η. AC supplies the prime/maximal ideal via Zorn; finite cover comes from quasi-compactness. Full source read at Stacks Schemes §26.19.7 and §26.22.2. Checked all declared dependencies and AC use.
